name: comp-593
title: Breadcrumb Filter Header
description: A quiet dark toolbar with a home-icon breadcrumb ending in Reports, a date range field that opens a month calendar, plus Filters and Saved buttons on the right.
use: A reports page needs its date range and filters in a persistent top strip.
avoid: The Filters and Saved buttons have no wired behaviour here, so you must connect them yourself.
a11y: Visible controls have names, including screen-reader text for the home icon; calendar internals live in a separate piece. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark header with a breadcrumb of a small home icon, a slash and the word Reports, then a date range trigger with a calendar icon, a Filters button and an outlined Saved button with a bookmark icon.
behaves: Clicking the date field opens a monthly calendar; choosing a day fills the trigger with a formatted date range and closes the picker. Filters and Saved only react on hover in the clip.
customise: The page title Reports is hardcoded; the date picker and filters are separate pieces configured in their own files.
weight: light: A breadcrumb, one date button and two small buttons.
